title: PackFeedIndex
description: The pack feed index that the data plane polls (INV-REQ-1079, INV-REQ-1195): one entry per published pack version. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4), like the payload schemas of this repository. Every version ever published stays listed, a superseded one included (INV-AC-2594). The feed itself is the external PackSource channel; this document declares no HTTP operation.

entries.description: One item per published pack version.

packContentHash.description: SHA-256 over the exact content of the pack version, computed by the publication gate (INV-Q-4878); a poller compares it with the checksum of the bundle it installs (INV-AC-2074).

supersedes.description: The packRef of the version this one supersedes; absent for a first version. A superseded version stays listed (INV-AC-2594).
